extracted.intended_audience: authors and teams preparing systematic reviews and evidence syntheses
extracted.subtask_description: Create a PRISMA 2020 flow diagram that documents the flow of records through the phases of a systematic review, choosing the template appropriate for whether the review is new or updated and which sources were searched.

rubrics_metrics.name: Depict flow of information through review phases
rubrics_metrics.description: The flow diagram depicts the flow of information through the different phases of a systematic review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Map how records move through identification, screening, eligibility, and inclusion phases so readers can follow the review process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Map numbers identified, included, excluded, and reasons for exclusions
rubrics_metrics.description: It maps out the number of records identified, included and excluded, and the reasons for exclusions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report counts at each stage (e.g., records identified, records screened, records excluded, full-text assessed, studies included) and provide explicit reasons for exclusions where applicable so the flow of decisions is transparent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Choose template appropriate to review type and sources searched
rubrics_metrics.description: Different templates are available depending on the type of review (new or updated) and sources used to identify studies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the matching template: 'PRISMA 2020 flow diagram for new systematic reviews which included searches of databases and registers only (Word)'; 'PRISMA 2020 flow diagram for new systematic reviews which included searches of databases, registers and other sources (Word)'; 'PRISMA 2020 flow diagram for updated systematic reviews which included searches of databases and registers only (Word)'; or 'PRISMA 2020 flow diagram for updated systematic reviews which included searches of databases, registers and other sources (Word)'. Flow diagrams can also be generated using the Shiny App at https://www.eshackathon.org/software/PRISMA2020.html.
